axes.correctness: Every value, condition, write and source pointer matches the code at the inspected revision; nothing is invented; gaps are disclosed.
axes.visual_design: Machines are cast by behaviour from the catalogue; one accent; calm tones; aligned main route; consistent spacing; both themes work.
axes.visual_clarity: A newcomer can name each structure from its shape and follow the item from input to output in under a minute without reading prose; no text walls.
axes.beauty: Each machine scores at least 8/10 on the beauty rubric in references/verify.md (solid body, one motif, cells belong, clean joints, calm, composed at rest), judged on the capture.mjs --machines sheet.

scoring.baseline: velocitty/factorio.svg made by the previous factorio-md skill was scored 9 correctness, 5 visual design, 3 visual clarity by the owner. A new run must beat 5 and 3 without dropping correctness below 9. Beauty: after the catalogue review on 2026-11-09 the owner rated the weakest machines 7.5/10; every machine must now reach 8 or more.
